summary: One church (St. Stanislaus Kostka, Garfield; Polish/English). Masses and Confession are printed identically in the schedule box of both bulletins read (Nov 8 and Nov 15) and on the website; intentions confirm Saturday 7 and 8 AM. Open: the convent Adoration Chapel (Mon-Sat 7 AM-7 PM, address not given) and whether first Thursday/Friday 6:30-7:30 PM Confession replaces the regular 6:30-6:55 PM window.
